data.gender_notes: Neeki is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-k-k', meaning 'to move', 'to be gentle'. In Islamic tradition, Neeki symbolizes the gentle, graceful nature of Allah, who moves in subtle ways in our lives. The name Neeki carries the meaning “Graceful, delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Neeki usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Emblem of Allah's gentle presence and guidance.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Neeki total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
